Package com.microservices.warehouse.storages.services

Class CommentService

java.lang.Object
com.microservices.warehouse.storages.services.CommentService
@Service public class CommentService extends Object
This service class provides operations for managing comments related to storage entities. It interacts with the repository layer to perform CRUD operations on comments.
Version:
1.0
